<mxfile host="Electron" scale="0.5" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="LgIHPcZFQs5gS6W4u0zM"> <mxGraphModel dx="1386" dy="2396" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "block-beta
 columns 5

 space:2
 TIME[\"DIM_TIME<br/>Calendar & Temporal Context\"]
 space:2

 CUSTOMER[\"DIM_CUSTOMER<br/>Canonical OCB Customer\"]
 space
 FACT[\"FACT_REMITTANCE<br/><br/>Grain: One row per<br/>Oman Remit remittance\"]
 space
 CHANNEL[\"DIM_CHANNEL<br/>Remittance Channel\"]

 space:2

 space:2

 space:2
 COUNTRY[\"DIM_COUNTRY<br/>Origin Country\"]

 space:2

 CUSTOMER --> FACT
 TIME --> FACT
 INSTITUTION --> FACT
 GEOGRAPHY --> FACT
 CHANNEL --> FACT
 COUNTRY --> FACT

 space:5

 NOTES[\"NOTES<br/><br/>• Conceptual star schema; not a physical table design.<br/>• Grain: one row per Oman Remit remittance.<br/>• dim_customer uses the canonical OCB customer key: ocb_customer_id.<br/>• dim_geography represents remittance location, not customer location.<br/>• dim_country represents the remittance origin country.<br/>• remittance_type remains a fact attribute; it is not a separate dimension.<br/>• Exact remittance timestamp remains on the fact for temporal analysis.<br/>• No destination-country attribute is introduced because it is not currently an observed Silver/Gold attribute.<br/>• Analytical measures and derived intelligence are excluded from this conceptual view.\"]",
 "config": null

div.span:
NOTES
• Conceptual star schema; not a physical table design.
• Grain: one row per Oman Remit remittance.
• dim_customer uses the canonical OCB customer key: ocb_customer_id.
• dim_geography represents remittance location, not customer location.
• dim_country represents the remittance origin country.
• remittance_type remains a fact attribute; it is not a separate dimension.
• Exact remittance timestamp remains on the fact for temporal analysis.
• No destination-country attribute is introduced because it is not currently an observed Silver/Gold attribute.
• Analytical measures and derived intelligence are excluded from this conceptual view.
